title: mklv.config.json
description: A project's only hand-edited configuration (ADR 0005). Every field is optional.

$schema.description: The schema editors validate this file against.

name.description: App identifier: the container image tag and the Cloud Run service name.

entrypoint.description: The file the app is built from, e.g. src/main.ts or cmd/web/main.go.

runtime.description: Runtime settings of the deployed service.

port.description: Port the app listens on. The Deno pipeline defaults it to 8000.

healthCheckPath.description: Health check endpoint path. Defaults to /health.

kind.description: What the project produces and how it ships (ADR 0006).

database.description: Cloud Run schema deployment. Defaults to Atlas when omitted.

tool.description: Schema CLI. Ptah uses the release pinned by the reusable workflow.

vars.description: HCL variable values passed to both preview and apply.

tools.description: Overrides merged onto each tool's base config. Objects merge deeply, lists are appended, {"replace": [...]} replaces a list, and null removes a key.

golangci.description: Merged onto the base .golangci.yaml, in golangci-lint v2's config schema.

markdownlint.description: Merged onto the base .markdownlint-cli2.yaml, which goldmark-lint reads, in markdownlint-cli2's config schema.

gitleaks.description: Merged onto the base .gitleaks.toml, in gitleaks' config schema written as JSON.

commitlint.description: Merged onto the base .commitlint.yaml, in conventionalcommit/commitlint's config schema.

misspell.description: misspell settings, passed as flags because misspell has no config file.

locale.description: US or UK also corrects the other locale's spellings. Empty is misspell's neutral default.

exclude.description: Path globs never checked; ** matches any number of directories.

ignore.description: Additions to the universal ignore files (ADR 0007).

override.description: A tool config override. The tool's own schema applies to its contents.
